question: What is revenue by product category?
referenceSql: SELECT p.Category, SUM(ol.Quantity * ol.UnitPrice * (1 - ol.Discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM dbo.OrderLines AS ol JOIN dbo.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = ol.ProductId GROUP BY p.Category ORDER BY p.Category
